lines.intro: The power's down on Floor {repairFloor} and the repair crew needs this lift. Press DOOR OPEN to wake her up.
lines.introDone: There she is. Lights, doors, motor. Let's get to work.
lines.reposition: Next call is on Floor {floor}. Hold on.
lines.hallCall: We've got a call on Floor {floor}. Press {floor} to pick it up.
lines.cuedFirst: We're on Floor {start}. The repair kit is {change} floors {dir}. Press the floor where it is.
lines.cuedNext: Floor {start}. The toolbox is {change} floors {dir}. Take us there.
lines.shaft: Shaft map time. We're at Floor {start}. The spare parts are {change} floors {dir}. Tap their floor on the map, or use the panel.
lines.stretch: The crew radioed: "We're {change} floors {rel} the beacon." The beacon is on Floor {start}.
lines.encounterRoute: Big job. The loading dock is {change} floors {rel} Floor {start}, where we are now.
lines.cargo: Load the car. It can carry {capacity} units. {aboard} are already aboard. Load as many as can safely go, then press DOOR CLOSE.
lines.twoMoves: Two-part trip: from Floor {start}, go {change} floors {dir}, then {changeTwo} floors {dirTwo}. The spare parts are waiting there.
lines.startFloor: The crew rode {change} floors {rode} and got off here, on Floor {end}. They left their toolbox where they got on. Take us there.
lines.express: Express service! This car stops at {firstStop}, {secondStop}, and on up, {step} floors at a time. The repair kit is at stop {count}. Which floor is that?
lines.tripMeter: Trip meter job. We're on Floor {from}. The crew is on Floor {to}. How many floors is that? Set the meter, then press GO.
lines.orders: Two orders: {orderA} crates for the crew, {orderB} for the roof. Load both, nothing else, then press DOOR CLOSE.
lines.arrivedWrongTwo: We reached Floor {floor}. The trip was {change} floors {dir} from Floor {start}, then {changeTwo} {dirTwo}.
lines.firstLegDone: First part done: Floor {floor}. Now {changeTwo} floors {dirTwo}.
lines.arrivedWrongStart: We reached Floor {floor}. The crew rode {change} floors {rode} to get to Floor {end}.
lines.arrivedWrongExpress: We reached Floor {floor}. The express stops at {firstStop}, {secondStop}, and on up. The kit is at stop {count}.
lines.arrivedWrongMeter: The meter took us {value} floors, to Floor {floor}. The crew is on Floor {to}.
lines.ordersWrong: That load doesn't match the orders: {orderA} crates and {orderB} crates.
lines.meterEmpty: Set the meter first: how many floors to the crew?
lines.finale: Full load. Take us to Floor {repairFloor}.
lines.finaleOnlyRepair: The crew is waiting on Floor {repairFloor}.
lines.arrivedWrong: We reached Floor {floor}. The job is {change} floors {dir} from Floor {start}.
lines.arrivedWrongBeacon: We reached Floor {floor}. The crew is {change} floors {rel} the beacon on Floor {start}.
lines.tryFromHere: Check the panel again. We can go from here.
lines.regenerated: New call coming in. A different job, same kind.
lines.overload: Overload. The car only takes {capacity} units in total. Take some off.
lines.underload: Safe to go, but the crew needs every unit we can carry. There is room for more.
lines.emptyLoad: Load the crates first. Drag them into the car.
lines.complete: Floor {repairFloor} has power again. That was real engineering.
lines.completeAgain: Floor {repairFloor} is running again. Ride anywhere you like.
lines.rankEarned: Engineer Rank 1. Your Engineer Log is on the clipboard. Ride anywhere you like.
lines.freeRide: The lift is all yours. Ride anywhere.
lines.doorCloseTip: Operator trick: DOOR CLOSE gets us moving sooner.
lines.logUnknown: Something here is worth a look.
lines.directoryNote: Every floor in the building. Ride there with the floor buttons.
lines.saveStuck: The logbook will not save right now. A grown-up can help.
lines.troubleBody: Everything saved before this moment is safe. TRY AGAIN reloads the game from the last save.
lines.sequence: Lamp check: the hall lamps go {pattern}. One lamp is out, and the crew is there. Take us to that floor.
lines.tens: Ten-floor express! From Floor {start}: one 10-floor jump {dir}, then {ones} more floors {dir}. The toolbox is there.
lines.tenJump: Ten-floor express! From Floor {start}: one jump of {jump} floors {dir}. The toolbox is where we land.
lines.tensFromZero: Ten-floor express from the bottom: one 10-floor jump up, then {ones} more floors. The toolbox is there.
lines.compare: Calls on Floors {callA} and {callB}. Going {dir} from Floor {anchor}, which do we reach {rank}? The crew is there.
lines.order: Calls on Floors {callA}, {callB} and {callC}. Going {dir} from Floor {anchor}, which do we reach {rank}? The crew is there.
lines.arrivedWrongSequence: We reached Floor {floor}. The lamps go {pattern}, {step} floors apart.
lines.arrivedWrongTens: We reached Floor {floor}. From Floor {start}: 10 floors {dir}, then {ones} more.
lines.arrivedWrongTenJump: We reached Floor {floor}. One jump is 10 floors {dir} from Floor {start}.
lines.arrivedWrongTensFromZero: We reached Floor {floor}. From the bottom: 10 floors up, then {ones} more.
lines.arrivedWrongCompare: We reached Floor {floor}. Going {dir} from Floor {anchor}, which comes {rank}: {callA} or {callB}?
lines.arrivedWrongOrder: We reached Floor {floor}. Going {dir} from Floor {anchor}, which of {callA}, {callB} and {callC} comes {rank}?

praise.afterMiss: You changed your plan. That worked.
praise.afterRescue: After that count, you worked this one out yourself.
praise.stretch: You worked out where the beacon was. Nicely done.
praise.cargo: Load accepted: the car is exactly full.
praise.orders: Load accepted: both orders are aboard.

misconceptions.quantity.countedStartingPosition: One floor short. Floor {start} is where we start. Count the floors after {start}.
misconceptions.quantity.countedOneExtra: One floor too far. The first floor {dir} from {start} is {first}. Count from there.
misconceptions.quantity.reversedDirection: We went the wrong way. The job is {dir} from Floor {start}, not {dirOpposite}.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithChange: {change} is how many floors to move, not where we stop. Start at {start} and move {change}.
misconceptions.quantity.ignoredExistingLoad: {aboard} units were already aboard before we loaded anything.
misconceptions.quantity.loadedEverything: Not everything fits in one trip. The car holds {capacity}.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithExistingLoad: We loaded as many as were already aboard. Check how much room is left.
misconceptions.quantity.ignoredSecondMove: That's where the first part of the trip ends. Then it goes {changeTwo} floors {dirTwo}.
misconceptions.quantity.sameDirectionTwice: The second part of the trip goes {dirTwo}, back the other way.
misconceptions.quantity.ignoredFirstMove: First go {change} floors {dir} from Floor {start}. Then {changeTwo} {dirTwo}.
misconceptions.quantity.repeatedTheMove: They rode {rode} to get here. Where they got on is back the other way.
misconceptions.quantity.oneJumpShort: One stop short. {firstStop} is stop 1 and {secondStop} is stop 2. Count to stop {count}.
misconceptions.quantity.oneJumpExtra: One stop too far. Count the stops again: the kit is at stop {count}.
misconceptions.quantity.addedInsteadOfMultiplied: That adds {step} and {count}. The express goes up {step} floors at every stop, for {count} stops.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithJumpCount: {count} is how many stops, not the floor. Each stop is {step} floors up.
misconceptions.quantity.countedBothEnds: One floor too many. Floor {from} is where we start: count the floors after it.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithTarget: {to} is the crew's floor. The meter wants how many floors away it is.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithStart: {from} is our floor. The meter wants how many floors to the crew.
misconceptions.quantity.countedOneGroupOnly: That's one order. Both orders go in the car.
misconceptions.quantity.tookEverythingWaiting: Some crates on the dock are for other jobs. Load only the two orders.
misconceptions.quantity.countedByOnes: The lamps go {step} floors at a time, not 1. Count {dir} by {step}s from {firstLamp}.
misconceptions.quantity.skippedATerm: One lamp too far. The lamps go {pattern}: count them again.
misconceptions.quantity.countedTenAsOne: One jump is 10 floors, not 1. Count 10 floors {dir} first.
misconceptions.quantity.ignoredTheOnes: That's the 10-floor jump. Then {ones} more floors {dir}.
misconceptions.quantity.ignoredTheTen: That's only the {ones}. The 10-floor jump comes first.
misconceptions.quantity.comparedOnesDigits: Every floor from 10 up is higher than every floor below 10. Look at the tens first.
misconceptions.quantity.reversedOrder: That's the other end. Going {dir} from Floor {anchor}, the calls nearest {anchor} come first.
misconceptions.quantity.choseListedOrder: That one was named {rank}. Going {dir}, the calls come in floor order.
misconceptions.quantity.reversedSecondMove: The second part goes {dirTwo} too, the same way as the first.
misconceptions.quantity.doubledOneGroup: That's one order twice. The orders are {orderA} and {orderB}, one apart.

focus.quantity.countedStartingPosition: The floor where we START is not one of the moves.
focus.quantity.countedOneExtra: We stop as soon as the count reaches the number of moves.
focus.quantity.reversedDirection: Up means bigger floor numbers. Down means smaller ones.
focus.quantity.answeredWithChange: The number of moves is not a floor. We start somewhere and move from there.
focus.quantity.ignoredExistingLoad: The units already aboard take up space too.
focus.quantity.loadedEverything: The limit is the most the car can hold, whatever is waiting.
focus.quantity.ignoredSecondMove: A two-part trip has two parts. We stop only after both.
focus.quantity.sameDirectionTwice: The second part goes back the other way.
focus.quantity.repeatedTheMove: To find where a ride started, undo it: go back the other way.
focus.quantity.oneJumpShort: Count stops, one for each jump. The bottom of the shaft is not a stop.
focus.quantity.addedInsteadOfMultiplied: Every stop is the same jump. Count the jumps, one per stop.
focus.quantity.countedBothEnds: The floor we start on is not one of the floors we travel.
focus.quantity.countedOneGroupOnly: Both orders go in the same car. Count on from the first.
focus.quantity.tookEverythingWaiting: Only the crates in the orders go. The rest stay on the dock.
focus.quantity.countedByOnes: The pattern jumps the same number of floors each time, not 1.
focus.quantity.countedTenAsOne: A ten is 10 floors, counted one by one.
focus.quantity.comparedOnesDigits: Floors from 10 up are higher than every floor below 10.
focus.quantity.reversedOrder: Going up, the lowest call comes first. Going down, the highest.
focus.quantity.reversedSecondMove: This trip goes the same way twice.
